title: Van Vihar National Park, Bhopal - A Complete Travel Guide
content:
Van Vihar National Park, Bhopal

Located on the banks of the Upper Lake (Bhojtal), Van Vihar National Park is one of Bhopal’s most peaceful and refreshing green spaces. Unlike traditional zoos, Van Vihar is a natural habitat park, where animals live in open enclosures with plenty of space and greenery. It is the perfect place for nature lovers, families, wildlife photographers, and morning walkers.

About Van Vihar National Park

Established in 1983, the park covers around 4.45 sq. km and is home to a variety of wild animals, birds, reptiles, plants, and migratory species. The park is managed carefully to keep animals in near-natural conditions.

Visitors can explore the park by walking, cycling, or using an electric vehicle. The fresh air, beautiful lake views, and lush green trails make it a relaxing experience.

Top Attractions & Things to Do

1. Wildlife Spotting: See tigers, lions, leopards, bears, hyenas, crocodiles, deer, and many reptiles in well-maintained open enclosures. It’s safe yet feels close to nature.

2. Bird Watching: Van Vihar is a paradise for bird lovers. During winter, migratory birds like pintails, egrets, and storks are commonly seen near the lake.

3. Nature Trails & Cycling: Walk or cycle through peaceful forest paths surrounded by tall trees and greenery. Cycles are available for rent.

4. Scenery Near Upper Lake: The lakeside route is the most beautiful part of the park—perfect for photography, sunset views, and enjoying the lake breeze.

5. Reptile Park: A dedicated area showcasing snakes, turtles, crocodiles, and other reptiles.

Timings & Entry Fee

Timings:

Summer: 6:30 AM - 6:30 PM

Winter: 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM

Entry Fee: Starts from ₹20-30 per person (extra for vehicles)

Closed: Every Friday

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March for pleasant weather
  • Early mornings for wildlife and photography
  • Winter for migratory birds

How to Reach

Van Vihar is located near Shyamla Hills, close to Upper Lake.

  • Nearest Railway Station: Bhopal Junction (8 km)
  • Nearest Airport: Raja Bhoj Airport (15 km)
  • Autos, cabs, and buses are easily available.

Visitor Tips

  • Wear comfortable shoes for walking.
  • Bring a camera/binoculars if you enjoy wildlife photography.
  • Carry water; it’s a long walk inside.
  • Best to visit in the morning.
  • Do not feed animals or disturb them.
excerpt: Van Vihar National Park in Bhopal offers a peaceful blend of wildlife, greenery, and lakeside beauty. With natural enclosures, walking trails, and migratory birds, it’s perfect for nature lovers and photographers. A must-visit destination for a refreshing escape within the city.
